params.name: limit
params.description: Number of datatakes to be returned per request. The actual number returned can be less depending on the workload of the server.

params.name: since
params.description: Return datatakes that were added to the catalogue since the given date.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token used to retrieve the next set of datatakes. Tokens do not expire and can be used for incremental updates on a weekly, daily, or even on a hourly schedule.

items.docs: Replicate the catalogue and retrieve latest datatakes.
Download the complete catalogue as vector dataset suitable for GIS analysis.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of revocations to be returned per request. The actual number returned can be less depending on the workload of the server.

params.name: since
params.description: Return revocations issued since the given date.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token used to retrieve the next set of revocations. Tokens do not expire and can be used for incremental updates on a weekly, daily, or even on a hourly schedule.

items.docs: Retrieve catalogue revocations, i.e. catalogue datatakes that cannot be ordered anymore.
